title: SG Rage
html:
SG_Rage is a status group.

Removal

The following spells/actions remove all conditions in this status group:

  • Calm Emotions
  • End Rage

List of conditions in SG_Rage

Condition Effects
A Mist Most Scarlet
  • Orin has gained 25 temporary hit points, a +2 bonus to Strength, and advantage on Wisdom  Saving Throws.
Berserk
  • A frenetic rage racks the affected entity's flesh. Its Multiattacks each deal an additional 1d8⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage and knocks targets  Prone
  • It also gains Resistance to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage, and has  Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.
  • This frenzy ends if the affected entity regains all its hit points.
Blood-scent Frenzy
  • Affected entity has  Advantage on melee attacks against any target that doesn't have all of its hit points, provided it's not a construct, an ooze, a plant, or an elemental.
Bloodlust
  • Creature can attack three times. It regains 3d8⁠⁠Hit Points if it lands a killing blow.
Bloodrender
  • Affected entity deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠piercing on all hits while taking 1d4⁠⁠piercing per turn.
Buthir's Wrath
  • Buthir is enraged! Strength increased by 4,  Armour Class reduced by 2.

Tactician Difficulty:

  • Buthir is enraged! Strength increased by 4, Armour Class reduced by 2, and has Resistance to all physical damage.
Deathbringer's Legacy
  • Sarevok is able to use  Deathbringer Assault until the end of his next turn.
  • Orin can use  Deathbringer Assault (Orin) until the end of her next turn.
Distressed
  • The owlbear has sustained damage to its eye. It cannot make Critical Hit and has  Disadvantage on Perception Ability Checks.
Festering Frenzy
  • This gnoll will become  Frenzied at the start of his next turn.
Frenzied
  • Deal an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has Resistance to physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Frenzied Fury
  • Overwhelmed with rage, the gnoll can attack three times per turn.
Frenzied Spores
  • Glut has increased hit points and Strength. It has access to more spore spells.
Induced Rage
  • The mix of chemicals has thrown the Owlbear into a fit of rage. It is stronger, jumps further, gains a multiattack, and can rupture the earth.
  • The Owlbear receives 4d8⁠Healing every turn if below  105 hit points.
  • The Owlbear has +2 Strength.
Owlbear's Rage
  • The owlbear is enraged! Strength and Constitution increased by 2, and gained  12 temporary hit points.
  • The owlbear has resistance to all ⁠Physical damageTTactician
Owlbear's Rage
  • The owlbear is enraged! Strength and Constitution are increased by 2.
  • The owlbear gains  12 temporary hit points.
Polma's Wrath
  • Polma is enraged! Strength increased by 4, Armour Class reduced by 2.
Rage
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, unarmed strikes, and while throwing objects.
  • Has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength Checks and  Saving Throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on Spells.
Rage
  • Deals an additional 2 + 1d4⁠⁠Slashing[See Notes] damage with melee attacks.
  • Is  Enlarged[See Notes].
  • Has Resistance to physical damage, and Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws.
  • Can use  Frenzied Strike (Boar).
  • Rage ends early if the boar didn't attack an enemy or take damage since its last turn.
Rage: Bear Heart
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to all damage except ⁠Psychic damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Eagle Heart
  • Can use  Dash as a  Bonus Action, and foes have  Disadvantage on  Opportunity Attacks.
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Elk Heart
  • Movement speed increased by 4.5 m (15 ft) and can use  Primal Stampede.
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Tiger Heart
  • Jump distance increased by 4.5 m (15 ft) and can use  Tiger's Bloodlust.
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Rage: Wolf Heart
  • Can use  Inciting Howl and allies have  Advantage on melee  Attack Rolls against enemies within 2 m (7 ft).
  • Deals an additional 2 (increased to 3 at level 9) damage with melee and improvised weapons, and when throwing objects.
  • Also has resistance to ⁠Physical damage, and  Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.
  • Cannot cast or concentrate on spells.
Seething Fury
  • Rage brews within the gnoll. Once it gives in to its fury, it'll be able to attack multiple times per turn.
  • This will evolve into Festering Frenzy and then Frenzied Fury, which will allow the gnoll to attack three times per turn.
Spider Queen's Wrath
  • Creature is enraged! Gained an additional attack per turn. Strength increased by 2,  Armour Class reduced by 1.
  • Tactician Difficulty: Creature is enraged! Gains an additional attack per turn. Strength is increased by 2 and has Resistance to physical damage.
Unbridled Wrath
  • Releasing a decade of pent-up rage in a blaze of infernal fury.
  • The affected entity is Immune to Fire damage.
